name: exportId
meaning: WAR export the car is built from: 0xa8 ALOCOM1B, 0xb4 AWAGON2A, 0xb5 AWAGON2B, 0xb3 AWAGON1B, 0xb2 AWAGON1A (Train_PostLoadInit 0x4ff1e0)

name: flags
meaning: 1 = the export existed and the body was built and added to the world; 4 = loads from DOCKA, 8 = from DOCKB (read as & 0xc then & 4 in Train_PlaceCars 0x4fd816); 2 and 0x10 are set by PostLoadInit but never read

name: body
meaning: the car's own scenaric body, vtable 0x576e7c: a ScnBody with only HandleMessage (+0x10) overridden, 0x501110. Train_Create 0x4fd5b0 constructs it as a real member

name: record
meaning: the synthesised WAR record Scn_BuildRecordFromExport writes and the body is initialised from
